notes: YOUR CASHBOOK NOW READS LIKE A CASHBOOK. Every line on a bank account's ledger used to end with your own organisation's name — the account you were already looking at — while who was paid and what for sat on the far side of the voucher. The narration now names the party and the purpose. This was corrected in sixteen places: payments, both receipt paths, vendor-bill settlement, payroll, the withholding, PAYE/SSNIT, VAT and tourism-levy remittances, fuel purchases and staff advances. LINES ALREADY ON YOUR LEDGER ARE CORRECTED TOO. This build rewrites the old wording on vouchers you have already posted. It changes WORDS ONLY — no amount, account, date, status or link is touched, so anything that balanced before balances after — it never guesses at a payee (it uses the voucher's own narration), and it only touches sentences the app itself wrote. Anything you typed by hand is left exactly as you typed it. Every change is recorded with the text it replaced, and can be put back. THE PAYMENT VOUCHER IS NOW A PAYMENT VOUCHER. It used to print the double entry — an Account column, a Debit column, a Credit column and the same total shown twice. It now prints what a voucher is for: the payee, what the payment covers, the gross, each deduction named (WHT, withholding VAT, the levy), the NET PAYABLE, the amount in words, and a signature block at the foot of the A4 sheet instead of stranded in the middle of it. The posting is still on screen for anyone who wants to check it — it simply no longer prints. A journal voucher keeps its double entry, because for a journal that IS the document. THIS BUILD CHANGES STORED TEXT. Please take a backup first — Backup & Export, Back up now.
